verdict.rationale: Superpowers is a skills and plugin framework for coding agents, and a product of this kind could plausibly offer a programmatic interface, so the axis applies. The evidence only documents slash commands (/brainstorm, /write-plan, /execute-plan) run inside host harnesses, plus install and porting mechanisms. Nothing describes a documented public API for driving the product programmatically; slash commands inside a host agent are an adjacent interaction mode, not an API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
